description: config:recommended ignores **/examples/**, but examples/respondeo is the published create-respondeo-app template and must stay dependency-identical to apps/web (enforced by scripts/check-template-sync.sh). Default list minus the examples glob.

packageRules.description: The matchJsonata on both patch groups requires the range's major.minor to be unchanged. When pnpm-lock.yaml already resolves the new version (e.g. pulled in transitively), a ^1.51.0 -> ^1.52.0 bump is typed 'patch' in apps/*, but 'minor' in the lockfile-less examples/respondeo, which split them into two PRs that each failed check-template-sync.sh.
create-respondeo-app is never automerged (see the last rule), so keep its patches out of the automerged group.

A fix(deps) commit touching create-respondeo-app triggers a Release Please release, so never automerge it. Positive glob on purpose: matchFileNames also tests the shared root pnpm-lock.yaml, so a negated glob would still match.
